scope: Curated starting points by brief type. Records are not_run blueprints; selection is a proposal, not approval or a runtime choice.

briefs.label: Logo reveal or brand ident
briefs.runtime_hint: HTML/SVG or GSAP; Remotion when the project already uses it
briefs.use: A protected mark keeps its geometry; animate surrounding shapes or approved parts only.
briefs.avoid: Animating letters of a protected logo or inventing parts that were not supplied.

briefs.label: Looping brand animation or idle ident
briefs.use: Make the first and last frames identical and keep the mark still.
briefs.avoid: Constant motion that competes with the mark.

briefs.label: Kinetic typography statement, title or slogan
briefs.use: Reveal whole lines or phrases and give each a full reading hold.
briefs.avoid: Per-letter animation of sentences or text moving while it should be read.

briefs.label: Single product feature highlight
briefs.use: Show only verified behaviour of the supplied product.

briefs.label: App, software or UI workflow demo
briefs.use: Use the real interface states supplied or approved; simplify, do not invent.
briefs.avoid: Fake screens or functionality the product does not have.

briefs.label: Physical product explainer, packaging or materials
briefs.runtime_hint: Remotion; Three.js through Remotion for true 3D
briefs.use: Keep the product geometry, label and colour locked to the source.
briefs.avoid: Physically implausible opening or invented internal structure.

briefs.label: Short vertical social reel
briefs.use: Design for the phone: large type, one idea, and current platform overlays checked through research.
briefs.avoid: Dense layouts or invented platform safe zones.

briefs.label: Event announcement or countdown
briefs.use: Keep title, date, place and time stable and readable together.
briefs.avoid: Fake urgency or moving the key facts during the hold.

briefs.label: Quote or testimonial card
briefs.use: Use only authorized quotations with correct attribution and a still reading interval.
briefs.avoid: Animating the quotation word by word or editing its wording.

briefs.label: Animated chart, statistic or number
briefs.runtime_hint: SVG with GSAP or D3; Remotion for data-driven variants
briefs.use: Use real data with units and source; keep scales stable.
briefs.avoid: Truncated axes, smooth growth implying a claim, or numbers without source.

briefs.label: Survey or poll results
briefs.use: Show the exact question, sample size and date with the results.
briefs.avoid: Rounding or ordering that changes the meaning.

briefs.label: Technical or process explainer
briefs.runtime_hint: SVG with GSAP; Remotion for longer sequences
briefs.use: One causal step at a time with persistent labels.
briefs.avoid: Decorative motion that hides the cause and effect.

briefs.label: Educational concept for a lesson
briefs.use: Conserve quantities visibly and give learners time to read each state.
briefs.avoid: Skipping steps or changing values between frames.

briefs.label: Editorial, news or document story
briefs.use: Keep sources and qualifications on screen with the claim.
briefs.avoid: Pulling quotes out of context or hiding citations.

briefs.label: Transition between scenes
briefs.runtime_hint: Same runtime as the surrounding scenes
briefs.use: Pick two or three transition types per project and repeat them consistently.
briefs.avoid: A different transition direction for every cut.

briefs.label: Motion synced to music, beat or voiceover
briefs.runtime_hint: GSAP or Remotion with the approved audio
briefs.use: Place major events on downbeats from a beat grid computed on the master timeline.
briefs.avoid: Cutting on every beat or estimating speech timing.

briefs.label: 3D product, architecture or spatial explanation
briefs.runtime_hint: Three.js / React Three Fiber through Remotion
briefs.use: Use supplied geometry and one measured camera move; keep labels honest.
briefs.avoid: Adding 3D to a brief that a 2D layout explains better.

briefs.label: Abstract or generative background
briefs.runtime_hint: Canvas or WebGL with a seeded, frame-driven state
briefs.use: Seed randomness and derive every frame from the frame number; keep text areas calm.
briefs.avoid: Busy patterns behind text or unseeded randomness.

briefs.label: End card, credits or thank-you
briefs.use: Give the final card the longest hold and a stable last frame.
briefs.avoid: Cropping the last credit mid-scroll or a moving final frame.
